summary: Full backend + frontend integration testing of Marca Rise MJ chatbot, certificate verification, and hidden admin panel. 21/21 backend pytest tests passed. Frontend flows (chat verify active/revoked/not-found, general LLM answer mentioning Sam, admin login wrong+correct, cert table, search, Excel upload preview with 3 detected + 1 existing) all worked. No secrets leaked in client bundle. Public site (navbar, hero, footer, Book a call widget bottom-right) intact; MJ launcher bottom-left, no overlap.

issues: Pre-existing hydration warning: nested <a> inside <a> in Footer service links (e.g. /services/branding). Not caused by this integration but should be cleaned up.

action_items: (Optional cleanup) Fix pre-existing Footer nested anchor hydration warning.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: startup uses ADMIN_PASSWORD env default 'admin123' — production must have ADMIN_PASSWORD set. Verified /app/backend/.env has correct MarcaRise@2026.
CORS allow_origins defaults to '*' with allow_credentials=True — browsers ignore credentials with wildcard, but consider explicit origins for production.
Public /api/verify uses PUBLIC_FIELDS correctly (student_id/remarks excluded). Confirmed via test.
Chat endpoint returns 200 even for LLM errors (graceful fallback text). Acceptable UX; consider 502 for observability.
extract_certificate_id regex is permissive (matches any hyphenated alphanumeric); works for MR26-XX pattern but could false-positive on other tokens.
seed_data_creation: Test created and cleaned up MR26-DS-00500 and MR26-DS-00501 via Excel import commit. MR00-XX-00000 has been updated by the 'update' duplicate_mode test (student_name now 'Arun Kumar UPDATED' from sample xlsx). If original name matters, main agent may want to re-seed MR00-XX-00000.
